evals.name: mixed-batch
evals.prompt: Download four links (one with sha256, one 404, one PDF URL answering with an HTML login page, one plain) and say when they are really done and which can be trusted.
evals.expected_output: Verified file reported as trusted, unhashed file flagged as unverified, dead and HTML links reported as not downloaded, nothing left waiting.
assertions: HTML response reported as not the file

evals.name: organize-night

evals.expected_output: Queue, categories and autoCategorize configured, tasks queued in the queue.

evals.name: stuck-downloads
evals.prompt: Diagnose and fix a stopped queue, an expired link with a fresh URL supplied, a hidden 1 KiB/s override, and remove a dead task.
evals.expected_output: All tasks completed, override cleared, dead task removed, each cause explained.
